remediation_details.remediation: Replace string concatenation with prepared statements
remediation_details.corrected_code_example: PreparedStatement statement = connection.prepareStatement("SELECT * FROM ? WHERE name = ?"); statement.setString(1, table); statement.setString(2, name);
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Using prepared statements prevents SQL injection by separating code from user input, ensuring that input is treated as data, not as part of the SQL command

findings.recommendation: Avoid shell execution with user input.

remediation_details.remediation: Use ProcessBuilder with sanitized input and avoid shell execution with user input
remediation_details.corrected_code_example: ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder("cmd", "/c", "dir"); pb.directory(new File("C:\\path\\to\\directory")); Process p = pb.start();
remediation_details.best_practice_explanation: Using ProcessBuilder instead of Runtime.exec helps prevent command injection attacks by allowing for more control over the execution environment and avoiding the interpretation of user input as shell commands.
